newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Apr rubber output for tyres up 3.3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Apr rubber output for tyres up 3.3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japanese rubber output for tyres totalled 94,330 tonnes in April, up 3.3 percent from the same month the previous year but down 4.0 percent from March, the Japan Automobile Tyre Manufacturers' Association said on Tuesday.
Domestic rubber shipments in April amounted to 52,673 tonnes, up 8.1 percent from the previous year but down 8.7 percent from March, the industry body said.
Exports of rubber for tyres in April totalled 39,288 tonnes, up 0.5 percent from the same month a year earlier but down 0.2 percent from March, it said.
Japan's rubber output for tyres in the first four months totalled 363,707 tonnes, up 2.6 percent from the same period a year earlier, the industry body said.
